output: Thanks for being direct about how the board pack gets built today. Spreadsheets stay part of most finance workflows, and it makes sense that Excel is where your team does the final formatting. Our spreadsheet add-in lets you refresh data and write changes back without a manual export each time, and our formatted report templates cover the common board and management layouts. Highly custom layouts may still be finished in a spreadsheet, so we would be clear about that up front. [PROOF] If it would help, I can rebuild one of your current spreadsheet reports with you in a short working session, so you can see where the add-in fits and where it doesn't.

messages.content:
<quote>
Every quarter my team exports everything to Excel to format the board pack, and I can't see that changing.
</quote>
